outcome_meanings.VERIFINGER_PREFLIGHT_PASS: every gate was asked and every gate passed
outcome_meanings.VERIFINGER_PREFLIGHT_INCOMPLETE: every gate that was asked passed, and some were not asked because a named action has not been performed. Nothing was found wrong with the route
outcome_meanings.VERIFINGER_PREFLIGHT_FAIL: a gate found something wrong with the route

decisive_question: Does an official, exact VeriFinger 2025.2 artifact let fpbench take canonical_500 in and get a reproducible raw 1:1 score out, with every externally selectable behaviour that can affect that score defined by Neurotechnology?
what_this_outcome_does_not_say: that the artifact could not be obtained
that the licence terms forbid research use
that canonical_500 cannot enter the official route
that the raw score is unsuitable
that the algorithm was developed on SD300
that any methodological blocker was found — none was

score_affecting_settings_without_provena.note: each profile gate counts its own settings; the total is derived here and labelled, so no single number stands for two different scopes (docs/adr/0104)

gates.summary: 2 official artifacts obtained from Neurotechnology's own download host and verified by size and SHA-256: the 4743229435-byte 2025.2 SDK archive and the 124277015-byte manual, which is byte-for-byte the manual inside the archive. One route was chosen — MAIN_SDK_PACKAGE — and 1 was not.

VENDOR_OFFICIAL_SDK: VeriFinger 2025.2 SDK by Neurotechnology, identified from inside the pinned bytes by 5 independent statements; 5 native libraries carry ProductVersion '2025, 2, 0, 0' and the archive declares revision 20260612. The runtime is locked to windows/x86_64 on 17.0.18, and no version here was read from a web page.

ALLOWED_UNDER_RESTRICTIVE_INTERSECTION with intended-use permission ESTABLISHED: every plausible reading of 2 notices inside the pinned archive permits one person executing this locally for non-commercial educational research. 5 restrictions are recorded and respected, and redistribution is NOT_ALLOWED — which changes nothing, because fpbench redistributes nothing.

closed over 8702 archive members totalling 6796855547 bytes, every one hashed. The fingerprint algorithm's 2 data files — 127187766 bytes — are inside the pinned archive, so nothing is fetched at first use and the EMBEDDED_IN_PINNED_VENDOR_ARTIFACT case does not arise for them. No external model, service or accelerator is required.

the pinned manual puts PNG in the official input domain, requires resolution attributes on a fingerprint image, and expresses minutia coordinates in 500 DPI units — which is what canonical_500 already is. Upstream's own 1:1 tutorial sets a file name and verifies: no crop, no resize, no rotation, no enhancement. All 7 refused preprocessing steps stay refused, and the segmentation and quality processing the SDK performs internally needs no external choice from fpbench.
14 published extraction settings inventoried; 0 carry a value from the authoritative sample and 8 were read off the constructed engine as delivered runtime defaults. No value was chosen by fpbench.

VENDOR_PROPRIETARY_TEMPLATE: the manual states that a packed proprietary template is what the matchers should receive, and upstream's 1:1 tutorial exports nothing. ISO and ANSI are export formats and MINEX is a separate matching scenario, so an interoperable route would be a different profile with its own identity. Only 4 facts about a template are publishable and the template itself is not among them.
6 published matching settings inventoried; 1 carry a value from the authoritative sample and 2 were read off the constructed engine as delivered runtime defaults. No value was chosen by fpbench.

NATIVE_TRANSFORMED_SCALAR: one integer per attempt, HIGHER_IS_MORE_SIMILAR, on the vendor's own claimed-FAR scale with 9 published anchor points. The threshold is a separate engine property and the sample reads the score under both outcomes, so no threshold is inside the number. fpbench converts nothing in either direction.

both orderings were scored on upstream's own sample fingerprints from the pinned archive, after the synthetic pair was rejected by the extractor and the score digests agree, so the route is symmetric on this evidence
SELF(A, A) produced a score from 2 independent extractions with no representation reused between the two sides, so the engine does not shortcut equal inputs
one fixture pair produced the same score digest at all 3 levels, including across a process restart
all 6 failure classes were exercised and each produced an outcome rather than a score

LICENSE_VALIDATION_ONLY: a constant connection is required during evaluation and the pinned agreement defines what it is for — checking a licence that permits the component to run on this computer. The biometric computation is local native code over local data files, so no part of the score depends on a service that could change without the pinned package changing.

measured on upstream's own sample fingerprints from the pinned archive, after the synthetic pair was rejected by the extractor, and on nothing else: startup 1029 ms, 7 end-to-end verify calls in 16024 ms (about 2289 ms each — one call loads both images, extracts both templates and matches them), about 8 MB of heap, no accelerator required. Orders of magnitude, not a benchmark, and no comparison with any other algorithm.

6000 verification attempts at the measured end-to-end latency project to about 3.8 hours, inside the 30-day trial window. No API-call quota is stated anywhere in the pinned activation guide, and that absence is recorded as an absence rather than read as permission.

PROPRIETARY_UNDISCLOSED with NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND: no pinned source mentions SD300 in any role, and none describes the corpus the algorithm was developed on. That is an absence of evidence, recorded as one and never converted into PROVEN_ABSENT. No score distribution was consulted to answer it.

qualification_run_steps: lock the platform and record the native libraries actually loaded
obtain the FingerExtractor and FingerMatcher licences from the local licensing service
read the library version from the running library
construct the engine and read every published setting's delivered default
extract a template from a synthetic fixture
extract a second template from the same fixture, independently
score both orderings of a fixture pair
score SELF(A, A) as two independent extractions
repeat one pair with the same objects, with fresh objects, and after a process restart
exercise each failure class and record what it returns
measure startup, end-to-end verification latency and peak memory
no_workaround_was_considered: no network disconnected to test whether matching is local
no reconstruction of the algorithm from documentation
no preset chosen from score distributions
no settings combined from two different upstream samples
why_the_search_stays_closed: No methodological blocker was found. Moving to another candidate while this one has an outstanding chore and no adverse finding would abandon the strongest candidate so far for a reason nobody could write down (docs/adr/0104).
